title: Ask better
label: A BETTER AI PROMPT IN 10 SECONDS

beats.say: Getting boring answers from AI? Your question might be the problem.
Say who you are and what you need, for example, I am a student and I need a simple summary.
Say the format you want, like three bullet points or a short email.
Add the details that matter, like the length, the tone, and who will read it.
If the first answer is off, say what to change, and ask again.
Try it on your next question, and send this to someone who says AI is useless.
